newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open lower, market still fragile.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open lower, market still fragile.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened lower on Monday after ending sharply higher on active short-covering on Friday. Brokers said there was concern in the market about possible profit-taking ahead of March 31 corporate book closings.
The Nikkei average of 225 leading issues was down 121.29 points, or 0.66 percent, at 18,208.72 in the first eight minutes of trade. Its March futures were 160 points lower at 18,180.

An analyst at a Japanese second-tier securities house said market sentiment remained bearish and that the Nikkei had only been lifted on Friday by comments by U.S. Federal Reserve Board Chairman Alan Greenspan, who said Japan was overly pessimistic about its economy.
